lines.t: (Intro)
Before the first light touched the sky,
Before the breath of life drew nigh,
You stood in endless, formless space,
Creation waiting for Your grace.
(Verse 1)
You called the dark to turn to dawn,
And shaped the earth to stand upon.
With just a word, the seas were bound,
And life awakened at Your sound.
Every star was placed with care,
Still You chose to meet me here.
(Pre-Chorus)
The hands that formed both sky and sea,
Are reaching out in peace to me.
(Chorus)
You spoke and life began to rise,
Painted wonder in the skies.
Every mountain, every shore,
Echoes what You’re worthy for.
Yet in all You’ve brought to life,
Through the beauty and the light,
You are here, so close to me,
In the calm of all You’ve made.
(Verse 2)
You shaped the dust and gave it breath,
Wrote the line of life and death.
Every creature, great and small,
Finds its place beneath Your call.
And You saw that it was good,
Just the way You said it would.
(Pre-Chorus 2)
I don’t have to strive or prove,
I am held by what You choose.
(Chorus)
You spoke and life began to rise,
Filled the void with endless light.
Every valley, every flame,
Carries whispers of Your name.
And the world You set in place,
Still reflects Your boundless grace.
I can rest inside the truth,
I am part of what You made.
(Bridge)
From the dust to destiny,
All creation sings of Thee.
Every breath and every tree,
Moves in quiet harmony.
(Build)
And in the stillness I can see,
This whole world was meant to be—
(Drop)
A living song… a grand design,
Held together by divine.
(Drop)
A living song… a grand design,
Held together by divine.
(Final Chorus)
You spoke and life began to rise,
Set eternity in time.
Every heartbeat, every soul,
Held within Your great control.
And the One who shaped it all,
Knows my name and hears my call.
In this life You gave to me,
I will rest in what You’ve made.
(Outro)
Let the rivers run their course,
Every star proclaim Your force.
In the beauty I can see,
The hand that crafted all I see…
Is still creating me.
